generator: sources/world-models/llm-recon-render/render_grid.py, which imports render_media.py from the same folder; run from that folder on rolly with robotl-reconstruction at commit e76cfb7 (datvo06/robotl-reconstruction PR #5) on its PYTHONPATH
rendering: MuJoCo offscreen, 512 by 512 pixels per panel in a 4 by 2 grid scaled to 75%, 48 frames at 16 fps. Every panel uses fitting view 4's camera. The ground truth sweeps each moving URDF joint between its limits; each reconstruction sweeps its own hinges and slides between their limits, or 0.6 rad and 0.15 around the fitted value when unlimited, which every selected program was.
